title: The 5 Longest Reigns in History, Ranked (#1 Ended in 1715)

scenes.text: The five longest reigns in history, ranked. Number one ended in 1715, and nobody has matched it.

scenes.label: Pakal · 68 years
scenes.text: Number five: Pakal of Palenque, a Maya king crowned at age twelve. Sixty-eight years on the throne.

scenes.label: Johann II · 70 years
scenes.text: Number four: Prince Johann the Second of Liechtenstein. Seventy years and ninety-one days, from 1858 to 1929.

scenes.label: Bhumibol · 70 years
scenes.text: Number three: King Bhumibol of Thailand. Seventy years and one hundred twenty-six days, ending in 2016.

scenes.label: Elizabeth II · 70 years
scenes.text: Number two: Queen Elizabeth the Second. Seventy years and two hundred fourteen days, the longest reign in British history.

scenes.label: Louis XIV · 72 years
scenes.text: Number one: Louis the Fourteenth of France. Crowned at age four, he reigned seventy-two years. No verified monarch has lasted longer.

description:
The five longest verified reigns in history, ranked.
Four of them lasted about seventy years, but the winner ruled for seventy-two, starting at age four.
Who would you have guessed was number one?
first_comment: Who did you think had the longest reign? And which list should we rank next?
